source: Dinner picks from Time Out St. Louis (Sept 2025) and St. Louis Magazine's Downtown & Midtown dining guide (updated Sept 2025); coordinates from latlong.net, latitude.to and mapcarta place pages

spots.name: Gateway Arch
spots.blurb: The 630-foot steel arch, with a tram ride to the top and a museum underneath
spots.blurbEs: El arco de acero de 630 pies, con tranvía hasta la cima y un museo debajo

spots.name: City Museum
spots.blurb: Giant climbable playground built from salvaged materials in an old shoe factory
spots.blurbEs: Enorme espacio de juegos para trepar, hecho con materiales reciclados en una antigua fábrica de zapatos

spots.name: Saint Louis Zoo
spots.blurb: Big free zoo in Forest Park
spots.blurbEs: Gran zoológico gratuito en Forest Park

spots.name: Missouri Botanical Garden
spots.blurb: Historic botanical garden with a Japanese garden and the Climatron conservatory
spots.blurbEs: Jardín botánico histórico con jardín japonés y el invernadero Climatron

spots.name: Tower Grove Park
spots.blurb: 289-acre Victorian park with ornate pavilions, a short walk from the Botanical Garden
spots.blurbEs: Parque victoriano de 289 acres con pabellones ornamentados, a poca distancia del Jardín Botánico
